units.source_text: 火苗把稻草堆积的复杂的影子描画了出来，

en.t: The flames traced out the intricate shadows of the piled straw,

units.source_text: 浮现出一片荒野的明晃晃颜色，浓重地传向四面八方。

en.t: and the glaring color of a stretch of wasteland emerged, spreading thickly in every direction.

units.source_text: 接着，火苗注身在腾起的烟云之中。

en.t: Then the flames poured themselves into the rising clouds of smoke.

units.source_text: 不料远处蚊帐的绿色膨胀起来，烈火熊熊燃烧，

en.t: Unexpectedly, the green of the distant mosquito net swelled up, and the fierce fire blazed violently,

units.source_text: 我感到四周顿时热闹起来了。

en.t: and I felt that everything around me had suddenly come alive with commotion.
